title: Removed the APIs deprecated for removal in 19.0: `saveManualColumnWidths()`, `loadManualColumnWidths()`, `saveManualRowHeights()`, `loadManualRowHeights()`, `Handsontable.helper.sanitize()`, the `columnHeaders` export option (use `colHeaders`), and the `Settings` and `DataProviderOptions` type aliases (use `ExportFileSettings` and `DataProviderFetchOptions`). Also fixed the `CollapsibleColumns` plugin warning that nested headers were missing when a sheet of the SheetsBar plugin declares them.
